name: Acid Storm
description: Electrified Rain that calls down lightning strikes, applying the Elec effect to enemies while dealing Acid damage.

name: Bandito Imbuement (Acid)
description: When Bandito comes in contact with Acid, it becomes imbued; dealing extra Acid damage and creating Acid puddles on the groumd.

name: Bandito Imbuement (Elec)
description: When Bandito comes in contact with Elec, it becomes imbued; dealing extra Elec damage and gaining extra movement speed.

name: Bandito Imbuement (Pyro)
description: When Bandito comes in contact with Pyro, it becomes imbued; dealing extra Pyro damage.

name: Bubble Split
description: In contact with an Elec puddle, Bubble will split into three other Bubbles!

name: Congregation
description: Upon contact with Pistolero, Wallo or Decoyo, Ritual creates an additional healing circle!

name: Decoyo Imbuement (Acid)
description: When Decoyo comes in contact with Acid, it becomes imbued; dealing extra Acid damage.

name: Decoyo Imbuement (Elec)
description: When Decoyo comes in contact with Elec, it becomes imbued; dealing extra Elec damage.

name: Decoyo Imbuement (Pyro)
description: When Decoyo comes in contact with Pyro, it becomes imbued; dealing extra Pyro damage.

name: Decoyo Imbuement (Voodoo)
description: When Decoyo comes in contact with Voodoo, it becomes imbued; corrupting nearby enemies.

name: Duplication
description: Any throwable spell that enters a portal comes out double through the second portal.

name: Energized Bridge
description: Upon contact with Elec, the Bridge will become energized, giving double the Shield Points and increasing your speed!.

name: Energized Wisp
description: Electrified Wisp moves faster, deals more damage and spreads fire!

name: Fire Tornado
description: A tornado of flame erupts that follows nearby enemies.

name: Frost Spikes
description: An area of Frost spikes emerges from the ground, dealing damage to enemies!.

name: Frost Wisp
description: Frost Wisp now deals Frost damage and freezes regular enemies!.

name: Geyser Split
description: Geyser will spawn 3 more Geysers in contact with an Elec puddle

name: Icicles
description: Upon contact with Bubble, the Bridge will send down a barrage of icicles, damaging enemies!.

name: Meteor
description: A massive purple doll drops from the sky and deals damage.

name: Mino Imbuement (Acid)
description: When Mino comes in contact with Acid, it becomes imbued; dealing extra Acid damage.

name: Mino Imbuement (Elec)
description: When Mino comes in contact with Elec, it becomes imbued; dealing extra Elec damage.

name: Mino Imbuement (Frost)
description: When Mino comes in contact with Frost, it becomes imbued; freezing nearby enemies.

name: Mino Imbuement (Pyro)
description: When Mino comes in contact with Pyro, it becomes imbued; dealing extra Pyro damage.

name: Mino Imbuement (Voodoo)
description: When Mino comes in contact with Voodoo, it becomes imbued; corrupting nearby enemies.

name: Needles
description: Using Drain on a corrupted Enemy or Bandito will create a large damaging aura.

name: Omnidirectional Strike
description: Upon contact with a stationary Cactus spell eight new strikes are cast from the Cactus.

name: Portal Collapse
description: Elec explosion caused by throwing a Portal inside of a Portal.

name: Volatile Geyser
description: Upon contact with Pyro, the Geyser will violently explode multiple times, dealing additional damage!

name: Votive Candles
description: When casting a Voodoo spell, nearby element puddles will create healing candles.
